Help Us Build What's Next at Mathnasium

Applicants must be located in the Los Angeles metropolitan area.

At Mathnasium, we believe every child has the ability to succeed in math—and we're passionate about helping them get there. Through our personalized approach to math learning, we help children build confidence, develop critical thinking skills, and discover what they're capable of.

Behind that mission is a dedicated corporate team working to support our franchise network, strengthen our technology, and help Mathnasium continue to grow. We're looking for a Software Developer who wants to be part of that work.

If you enjoy solving problems, building useful solutions, exploring new technologies, and seeing your work make a real impact, this could be a great next step in your career.

The Opportunity

As a Software Developer at Mathnasium, you'll join a collaborative, hands-on engineering team where your contributions matter. You'll work on applications and services that support our business, deliver meaningful improvements to our users, and help shape how our technology evolves.

Our team works across a mature C# and ASP.NET Framework application and newer TypeScript services.

We're looking for someone with a solid foundation in software development who is ready to take the next step: owning meaningful work, growing their technical capabilities, and becoming more independent over time. You'll have support from an experienced team, opportunities to contribute ideas, and room to expand your responsibilities as your skills develop.

You don't need to know everything on day one. If you're strong in .NET and excited to learn more about AWS serverless development, automation, and AI-powered tools, we're ready to help you grow.

What You'll Work On

Build Features That Matter: Develop and enhance applications that support Mathnasium's business operations and customer needs using C#, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, and serverless TypeScript services.
Help Modernize Our Technology: Improve existing applications, reduce technical debt, and move functionality into modern services where it makes sense.
Make Releases Faster and Smarter: Help evolve our software delivery process from monthly releases to two-week releases and, ultimately, continuous deployment using GitHub Actions and related tools.
Explore Cloud Development: Build and support services using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and other cloud technologies as you develop your serverless skills.
Automate and Improve Quality: Write automated tests, expand test coverage, and identify opportunities to eliminate repetitive work through better tooling and automation.
Work With Data: Build and maintain functionality that interacts with Microsoft SQL Server, Aurora SQL, and DynamoDB.
Explore What's Next in AI: Help evaluate emerging AI tools and experiment with AI-powered features and agentic workflows that could improve how we build software and support our business.
Keep Our Applications Running Well: Help troubleshoot production issues, improve monitoring and alerting, and address root causes to keep our systems reliable.
Learn and Collaborate: Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and documentation while sharing ideas and learning from teammates.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a developer who brings technical fundamentals, curiosity, and a willingness to take ownership. You should be comfortable contributing independently while knowing when to ask questions, collaborate, and learn from others.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of professional software development experience.
Strong experience with C#, ASP.NET MVC or Web API, and object-oriented programming principles.
Experience with TypeScript or modern JavaScript, including Node.js, along with HTML and CSS.
Solid SQL skills and experience working with Microsoft SQL Server.
Hands-on experience with AWS or another cloud platform.
Experience working in an Agile development environment with Git/GitHub, code reviews, and automated testing.
Strong problem-solving skills, clear communication, and the ability to manage assigned work independently.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Skills We'd Love to See

You don't need to check every box. We're interested in your foundation, your curiosity, and your ability to learn.

Experience with AWS serverless technologies, including Lambda, API Gateway, and DynamoDB.
Familiarity with infrastructure as code using Terraform and/or the Serverless Framework.
Experience with Aurora SQL.
Exposure to Amazon S3, Redis, or Valkey.
Experience designing REST APIs with Express, NestJS, or similar frameworks.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, particularly GitHub Actions, as well as Docker and monitoring tools such as Amazon CloudWatch.
Experience with LLM APIs, agent frameworks, or AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude.
Exposure to migrating .NET Framework applications to modern .NET or breaking functionality into independent services.

How You'll Grow Here

At Mathnasium, we want you to build more than features—we want you to build your skills and confidence as a developer.

You'll begin with clearly scoped projects, collaboration, and support from the team. As you become familiar with our systems and development practices, you'll have opportunities to take on more complex challenges, contribute to technical decisions, and own larger pieces of work.

You'll also have room to explore new tools and technologies. Our approach to AI-assisted development and agentic workflows is still evolving, and you'll have an opportunity to help evaluate tools, share ideas, and influence how we incorporate these capabilities into our engineering practices.

We're looking for someone who is eager to keep learning, comfortable with change, and excited to grow into greater technical ownership over time.

Our Technology Environment

Our engineering team works across established applications and evolving cloud-based services, including:

Application Development: C#, ASP.NET Framework, MVC, Web API, Node.js, and TypeScript
Cloud & Serverless: AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Aurora SQL, and Amazon S3
Data: Microsoft SQL Server and cloud-based databases
Development & Delivery: GitHub, GitHub Actions, automated testing, Terraform, and the Serverless Framework
Emerging Technology: AI coding assistants, LLM integrations, and agentic workflows

You won't be expected to master every technology before joining us. We value a strong technical foundation, adaptability, and the ability to learn new tools as our environment evolves.

Where You'll Work

This is a hybrid position based at Mathnasium's corporate headquarters in the Los Angeles metropolitan area.

Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday: Work onsite with the team at our headquarters.
Tuesday and Friday: Work from home.

We're looking for someone located in the Los Angeles metro area who can regularly collaborate with the team in person and participate in our hybrid work schedule.

Why Mathnasium?

Mathnasium is more than a network of learning centers. We're a team committed to helping children build confidence in math and develop skills that can serve them throughout their lives.

At our corporate headquarters, every department plays a part in supporting that mission. As a Software Developer, your work will help strengthen the systems, tools, and technology that support our business and franchise network.

You'll join a collaborative environment where your ideas matter, your contributions reach real users, and you can continue developing your skills while helping build what's next.

If you're ready to take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and grow alongside a supportive team, we'd love to hear from you.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

This role is part of Blue National Security (BNS), where our focus is the design, development, and delivery of launch and spacecraft systems for national security missions. Through Blue Ring, our all-in-one, high-powered hybrid solar-electric and chemical-propelled spacecraft, we provide unmatched mission maneuverability, versatility, and capacity at dramatically lower-profile costs.

This role is part of the Blue National Security unit and supports Blue Origin’s Quartz program. Quartz is building out a global network of Blue Origin owned and operated ground infrastructure. Quartz will be used by Blue Origin businesses and external customers providing reliable, flexible, and cost-effective communications services between Earth and space.

Our Quartz program is looking for experienced personnel to join their team. We’re a group of problem-solvers with diverse skillsets, building and operating the ground stations that serve as the critical link connecting space to Earth. Working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, you’ll contribute innovative solutions while demonstrating personal leadership, technical competence, and attention to detail. This position will directly impact the history of space exploration and demands your dedicated commitment to safe, reliable spaceflight.

We are seeking an experienced Ground Software Engineer to support the development of our mission-critical operational platforms managing our global ground station network. In this role, you will architect and implement solutions that form the vital communications backbone between Earth and space operations.

Working closely with cross-functional engineering teams and external customers, you will deliver scalable, secure, and highly reliable solutions that ensure continuous ground station availability for mission-critical spacecraft communications while providing sophisticated planning capabilities that maximize operational efficiency across the entire ground network.

Enterprise Architecture Is An Organization Within The Chief Technology Office At American Express And It Is a Key Enabler Of The Company’s Technology Strategy. The Four Pillars Of Enterprise Architecture Include

Architecture as Code: this pillar owns and operates foundational technologies that are leveraged by engineering teams across the enterprise.
Architecture as Design: this pillar includes the solution and technical design for transformation programs and business critical projects which need architectural guidance and support.
Governance: this pillar is responsible for defining technical standards, and developing innovative tools that automate controls to ensure compliance.

Lead the architecture and implementation of distributed systems, ensuring performance, reliability, and maintainability

Act as a senior member of an Agile team, driving best practices in coding standards, testing, documentation, and continuous delivery
Mentor and guide junior engineers, providing technical leadership through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing
Collaborate closely with architects, product managers, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions

Proactively identify system bottlenecks, debug complex issues, and drive root-cause analysis with long-term fixes
Design systems for scalability, resilience, and observability, including monitoring, logging, and alerting strategies
Contribute to cloud-native adoption, including containerization, infrastructure-as-code, and auto-scaling architectures
Influence technical direction and challenge the status quo by proposing innovative, pragmatic solutions
Take ownership and accountability for delivering high-impact outcomes aligned with team and organizational goals

Deep experience with Java ecosystems and frameworks such as Spring, Spring Boot, or equivalent

Strong experience building RESTful APIs, microservices architectures, and service-to-service integrations

Experience with API design standards, OpenAPI/Swagger, versioning, and contract-driven development
Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.)

Build digital health products that improve millions of lives.

As an Associate Software Engineer
, you'll help create modern digital health experiences that support patients and healthcare providers around the world. Working alongside engineers, product managers, designers, and cross-functional partners, you'll turn real-world problems into software that is reliable, secure, scalable, and meaningful.

This is an opportunity for someone who is curious, adaptable, and excited by the future of software engineering. We are looking for engineers who want to understand the problem behind the code, take ownership of outcomes, and explore how AI is transforming the way software is designed, built, tested, and operated. If you're eager to learn, enjoy experimenting with new ideas, and want your work to have a direct impact on customers, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Design, build, test, deploy, and operate reliable, secure, and scalable cloud-native applications and services.
Contribute to features from idea through production, helping solve real customer problems and measuring outcomes after release.
Use AI-assisted development tools and coding agents to support development, testing, debugging, documentation, code review, and learning.
Experiment with emerging AI-enabled engineering workflows and share learnings with teammates.
Develop clean, maintainable software and APIs using modern engineering practices.
Build applications with performance, security, privacy, reliability, and scalability in mind.
Participate in technical design and architecture discussions while learning from experienced engineers.
Collaborate with Product, UX, Quality, Security, and Engineering teams to deliver practical customer-focused solutions.
Use data, telemetry, and customer feedback to improve products and software experiences.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive work, simplify systems, and improve developer productivity.
Participate in code reviews, automated testing, deployments, production support, and incident learning activities.
Continuously learn new technologies and contribute ideas that improve how the team works.

What You Bring

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
2+ years of software development experience.
Strong programming fundamentals and experience with at least one modern programming language.
Understanding of APIs, testing, version control, debugging, and core software engineering principles.
Ability to collaborate effectively, communicate technical ideas, and learn from feedback.
Curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to learn new technologies.
Ownership mindset with a genuine interest in understanding customer and business problems.
Interest in AI-assisted software engineering and how emerging tools can improve software development.

Experience with AWS or another cloud platform.
Familiarity with Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Kotlin, Swift, or similar languages.
Experience using AI coding tools or agents such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar technologies.
Exposure to APIs, automated testing, CI/CD, or modern software delivery practices.
Interest in AI, automation, and emerging technologies.

Product Curiosity: You want to understand the customer problem and business outcome, not just the technical requirements.
Growth Mindset: You actively seek feedback, embrace new ideas, and continually look for opportunities to learn.
Ownership: You take responsibility for outcomes and follow through on commitments from start to finish.
Experimentation: You enjoy testing new approaches, learning from results, and sharing insights with others.
Adaptability: You stay open to changing technologies, evolving ways of working, and new challenges.
Collaboration: You build strong relationships, contribute positively to team discussions, and support those around you.

At Resmed, our mission is to improve lives through better health technology. You'll be part of a team developing products that help people live healthier, higher-quality lives while working at the intersection of healthcare, cloud technology, and AI.

You'll have the opportunity to work on meaningful products, collaborate with talented colleagues, and contribute to technology that makes a real difference for customers around the world.

Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. If this sounds like the workplace for you, apply now! We commit to respond to every applicant.

added.description:
As part of the Reailize and B-Yond group, you’ll be joining a team that is redefining how technology powers businesses worldwide. We combine global expertise in AI, automation, and network transformation with a culture that values innovation, creativity, and impact. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to work on groundbreaking projects, grow your skills, and be part of a group that’s shaping the future of technology.

About The Role

We are looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer to join our DevOps team to primarily design, develop and test applications for internal software systems. You will work with the customer’s industry leading automation and technology Subject Matter Experts for the 5G core network to automate deployment and upgrades of 5G Core Network Functions. You will be working with state-of-the-art technology in containerized applications, Azure, CI/CD, workflow engines and software. These systems automate the process of capturing customer’s mobility services design, and network design to aid in the planning, design, deployment, configuration, and management of the network functions that are part of each service definition.

This opportunity requires onsite presence twice a week out of any of these locations

:

Texas: Austin, Dallas, Plano
New Jersey: Middletown, Bedminster
Georgia: Lenox/Atlanta, Alpharetta
Washington: Bothell, Redmond

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain full-stack web applications using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js)
Build and maintain scalable, secure, high-performance RESTful APIs and backend services.
Develop responsive, reusable UI components in React, emphasizing usability and maintainability.
Design and optimize MongoDB data models, indexes, and queries to support application performance and scalability.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to translate business requirements into well-scoped technical solutions.
Ensure high-quality deliverables through testing, code reviews, performance tuning, and security best practices.
Integrate and maintain third-party APIs and internal services.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the stack (frontend, backend, database, CI/CD).
Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
Participate in Agile ceremonies (planning, standups, retrospectives) and deliver iteratively.

Required Qualifications

Proven experience building production web applications using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js)
Strong JavaScript fundamentals (ES6+), including writing clean, modern, maintainable code.
Solid experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs using Node.js + Express.js.
Strong React skills including hooks, component architecture, and practical state management patterns.
Working knowledge of TypeScript (able to read/write TS in a React/Node codebase).
Experience integrating backend services with MongoDB (schemas, query optimization, indexing).
Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, including Azure DevOps (ADO) YAML pipelines for React/Node services.
Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills; able to quickly read and improve existing code.
Strong understanding of authentication/authorization (e.g., JWT, OAuth/OIDC) and secure API patterns.
Proficiency with Git and collaborative workflows (PRs, reviews, branching strategies).
Familiarity with cloud fundamentals—especially Azure concepts relevant to deploying and operating web services.
Ability to work effectively in an Agile, cross-functional environment with strong ownership and communication.

Nice To Have

Experience with Next.js or other React frameworks.
Experience with one or more React state libraries (Redux, Zustand, etc.)
Experience with Docker and container-based workflows.
Deeper experience with DevOps tooling beyond pipelines (infra-as-code, monitoring/observability, release automation).
Experience with workflow/BPM engines (e.g., Camunda (BPMN)) or similar orchestration platforms (including Pronghorn).
Experience with alternative clouds (AWS/GCP) in addition to Azure.

Don’t meet every requirement?

Studies show that many qualified candidates, especially women and underrepresented groups may hesitate to apply unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If you meet around 50% of the requirements and are excited about this role, we strongly encourage you to apply. We value potential, learning ability, and diverse perspectives as much as direct experience.

Interview Integrity

During the interview process, we're evaluating your individual problem-solving skills, creativity, and approach to challenges. While AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor are part of your daily toolkit once you join B-Yond, all interviews, assessments, and take-home assignments must be completed independently.

You may not use AI tools, third-party services, coaching platforms, or content-farming services during any part of the interview process unless we explicitly permit it. We will clearly communicate when AI tools are allowed for specific assessments.

Any indication of third-party assistance or AI-generated responses will result in immediate disqualification.

position, however, the candidate must live in San Diego, CA or surrounding areas.

Our mission is to empower ResMed's developer community with an opinionated, yet empathetic developer experience that avoids surprise, is a joy to use, and abstracts the complexities of modern development to accelerate the pace of ResMed’s next generation Healthcare Informatics platform.

As a Software Engineer, you must possess world class technical skills and a strong sense of empathy for your fellow developers. You will work closely with other talented engineers, architects and stakeholders to architect, implement, and deliver on our roadmap.

Responsibilities And Accountabilities

You have a developer first mentality with a deep empathy for the challenges of modern software development.
You have experience with full lifecycle of product development from inception to happy customers.
You are comfortable presenting your ideas to your peers, team members and management.
You will drive our inner sourcing/open sourcing strategy and help drive ResMed’s developer community in that direction.
You will build our cloud native mindset and drive our architecture towards it.
You will build and maintain observability and reliability of our services.
You will participate in a 24/7, follow the sun on call model for production incident management including weekends and holidays.
You will drive and implement improvements in developer tools and automation.
You will research, design, implement, test, and document your solutions to the technical problems as assigned.
You will collaborate across the enterprise to drive consensus and understanding.

BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Information Technology or equivalent experience.
2+ years of professional software development experience.
Experience with public cloud (AWS) and cloud computing concepts.
Strong knowledge of computer science fundamentals and experience with at-least one programming language such as Java, JavaScript, Python, Go, Typescript, React etc.
Understanding of test practices regardless of language or tools.
Basic knowledge of source control, pull requests and automated quality gates using tools such as GitHub, Bitbucket etc.
Passion for learning and problem solving.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Knowledge of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) concepts and practices is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications
:

Experience building services using cloud native technologies including Kubernetes, Docker, serverless, etc. is a plus
Production experience building and operating Kubernetes clusters in public cloud is a plus.
Experience monitoring infrastructure with monitoring and logging tools such as Datadog, Splunk, ELK etc.
Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, experience with on-call rotation and incident management.

Vehicle Control Development

Contribute to the design and implementation of the vehicle control architecture.
Implement logic on the central high-performance embedded computer running Linux and distributed real-time microcontrollers.

ROS2 Control Implementation

Implement ros2_control hardware interfaces that abstract complex custom hardware into standard interfaces.
Develop firmware and drivers to interface ROS2 with low-level custom hardware boards via:
CAN-FD (J1939 / CANopen)
I2C
SPI
UART

Algorithm Design

Design and tune closed-loop control algorithms (PID, MPC, LQR) to manage vehicle dynamics.
Actuate multi-DOF systems with precision and implement controllers within ROS2.

Hardware Interface, Sensor Fusion & Instrumentation

Integrate sensors including IMUs, encoders, LiDAR, GPS, and pressure transducers.
Create accurate vehicle state estimates through sensor fusion.

Hydraulic Systems Control

Model and control complex non-linear hydraulic systems (valves, pumps, cylinders).
Convert digital control commands into fluid power actions.

I2C
SPI
RS485
